correctness.rationale: Exposed vertex masks are exactly the 62 nonempty proper subsets. The six standard parallelotopes give volume 6D. The full reproducible exact integer computation checks all 17,847,441 orbit-representative candidate completions, obtaining maxima 14,17,18, and all 38,760 central-layer candidates with two distinct determinant routines, obtaining exactly 30 maxima at 18. Matching cycles enumerate 30 equal winning sets; all 180 five-vertex deletions are distinct. A separate determinant multi-affinity argument excludes additional nonvertex maximizers. The normalized optimal volume is 18D/5!=3D/20, hence ratio 1/40. No finite experiment is used as a proof for an unbounded family.

originality.rationale: The standard order-six binary determinant maximum 9 already covers the numerical 18 determinant within the constant-cardinality-three layer (by a factor-two relation); that numerical computation alone is not novel. The proposed distinct claim is the global comparison across all subset layers, its 1/40 volume ratio, 30 pair-cycle classification and exclusion of nonvertex equality. The original 2013 zonotope article establishes definition/cubulation and studies topological fair division rather than contained-simplex volume. The 2024 hypersimplex study treats subdivisions and their orbit counts rather than this optimized volume. Cube maximal-simplex papers optimize in the cube rather than its fixed projection and thus do not imply this result merely by their titles or abstracts. Search across shape, determinant, equal-volume ratio, hypersimplex, perfect-matchings, and dual root-body formulations found no identifiable dominating statement. An inaccessible older 1996 full text leaves a genuine historical overlap risk; this PASS assesses material comparisons, not global novelty certification.

value.rationale: Maximal contained-simplex volume is a geometrically natural affine-invariant quantity. Five-dimensional simplex-generated zonotopes are a canonical higher-dimensional rhombic-dodecahedral family, and the exact sharp ratio 1/40 and classification of every maximizer through perfect matchings and cyclic orientations are nontrivial finite-dimensional structure. This is not a routine substitution or a bare arbitrary computation; the 62-vertex global extremum and nonvertex rigidity link the finite certificate to a whole infinite affine family.
